svg.aria-label: Character sheet. Class: Full Stack and Mobile, Cloud Native. Level: junior, 1 year and 1 month in industry. Base: Bilbao, Spain. Guilds: Batura Mobile, Grupo Radimer, BeXReal. Origin: Started in IT systems (SMR), took a 300-hour Unity course between the first and second year of my DAM degree, and went on to specialize in Cloud Native (600 h). Languages: Spanish native, Basque B1, English intermediate. Training: RAG and generative AI, then DevSecOps. Experience: 796 contributions and 123 active days in the last year. Skills: TypeScript 44.8 %, JavaScript 23.0 %, Python 13.0 %, Swift 8.4 %, Java 4.7 %, CSS 2.3 %.
